description: Native iPhone & iPad console for Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents on your own machines. Connect over SSH to Herdr TUI, herdr-core, or tmux.
summary: Native iPhone and iPad console for herdr: watch and drive coding agents on your machines over SSH, in Herdr TUI or the Herdr desktop app (herdr-core), with a real libghostty terminal, native Chat, QR pairing, and push notifications when an agent needs you
